templates.name: Homepage
templates.purpose: Route visitors into the correct market or estimate path while establishing trust immediately.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component page; client islands only for navigation, media controls, analytics, and interactive proof.
templates.notes: Do not lead with generic company history.

templates.name: Market Landing
templates.purpose: Explain fit, constraints, proof, and next step for one market.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component with evidence and FAQ data from published Convex content.

templates.name: Service Detail
templates.purpose: Answer service-specific questions and convert relevant visitors without thin SEO duplication.
audience: prospect searching for a named service
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component. Route registry and published content determine existence.

templates.name: Service Area Hub
templates.purpose: Show credible coverage and help visitors find their location path.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server page with optional client search/map island.

templates.name: Location Detail
templates.purpose: Connect local relevance to real scope and proof without doorway-page duplication.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component; local proof appears only when a verified project/location relationship exists.

templates.name: Projects Index
templates.purpose: Present verified work as evidence and allow filtering by market/service/location.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server-render initial projects; client filter island uses published DTOs.

templates.name: Project Detail
templates.purpose: Show a source-backed challenge, preparation, execution, and result.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component; interactive media only as client island. No generated image is project proof.

templates.name: Estimate Wizard
templates.purpose: Collect a qualified scope with minimum friction and provide an honest planning range.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Client wizard backed by server/Convex mutations. Browser stores only opaque resume token.

templates.name: Contact
templates.purpose: Offer direct contact and a short qualified alternative to the estimate wizard.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server page with client form island.

templates.name: About
templates.purpose: Build confidence through owner story, operating principles, and verified facts.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component. No invented biography details.

templates.name: Capabilities
templates.purpose: Give commercial, facility, prime, and agency buyers a concise qualification view.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component; downloads use governed public documents only.

templates.name: Referral
templates.purpose: Create an opaque referral link and explain verified terms without exposing PII.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Client form backed by server-issued signed code; no email in URL or analytics.

templates.name: Review
templates.purpose: Offer the same honest public-review path to every customer while providing an independent support route.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Public path is equal regardless of rating; support is a separate choice.

templates.name: Resources Index
templates.purpose: Help prospects make project decisions and create a governed SEO/content hub.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server-render published resources; optional client filters.

templates.name: Resource Article
templates.purpose: Answer one practical project question with sourced guidance and a contextual next step.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component, published content only.

templates.name: Portal Sign-in / Invite
templates.purpose: Authenticate customers and accept invitations without open staff registration.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Clerk client components with server route protection and Convex identity sync.

templates.name: Legal / Privacy
templates.purpose: Explain data handling and terms in plain language.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server Component; text requires legal review before production.

templates.name: 404 / Error
templates.purpose: Recover from an invalid or failed route with useful next actions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server error boundary where possible; no canonical/indexable metadata.

templates.name: Customer Overview
templates.purpose: Show project status and one most important next action.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server-authorized DTO; client islands for interactions.

templates.name: Customer Project Detail
templates.purpose: Provide one project source of truth for status, scope, schedule, files, and approvals.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Explicit project grant required.

templates.name: Appointment Detail
templates.purpose: Show confirmed appointment facts and controlled reschedule/cancel actions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Provider state reconciled server-side.

templates.name: Estimate Review
templates.purpose: Present a versioned estimate with scope, assumptions, exclusions, and next step.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Authorized DTO; immutable issued version.

templates.name: Proposal Review
templates.purpose: Turn an approved scope into a clear decision document.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Approval records actor, version, timestamp, and evidence.

templates.name: Agreement Signature
templates.purpose: Provide clear agreement review and evidence-backed signature.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Signature implementation requires legal and evidence review.

templates.name: Payment
templates.purpose: Show payment state and launch a hosted Stripe Checkout session when authorized.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Test mode until production approval. No card data handled by app.

templates.name: Customer Files
templates.purpose: List only files the customer is authorized to access.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Short-lived authorized transfer after project grant.

templates.name: Change Order
templates.purpose: Explain scope, schedule, and price impact before approval.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Immutable decision evidence.

templates.name: Messages / Updates
templates.purpose: Provide a controlled project update stream and customer response channel.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Messages are project-scoped and audited.

templates.name: Customer Account
templates.purpose: Manage identity-facing preferences without changing resource ownership implicitly.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Clerk identity; ownership changes require explicit reviewed process.

templates.name: Operator Overview
templates.purpose: Prioritize work, risk, and revenue with direct next actions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server-authorized staff DTOs; live islands for queue actions.

templates.name: Lead Inbox
templates.purpose: Triage new and unresolved intake with SLA visibility.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Staff grant required; bulk destructive actions separately confirmed.

templates.name: Pipeline Board
templates.purpose: Visualize and advance opportunities through explicit stages.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server validates every transition.

templates.name: Opportunity Detail
templates.purpose: Combine contact, property, scope, activity, tasks, documents, and revenue next step.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Canonical opportunity aggregate.

templates.name: Contact / Property Detail
templates.purpose: Maintain durable relationship and property facts separately from identity text.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Merges require reviewed evidence; email alone is not identity.

templates.name: Calendar
templates.purpose: Coordinate appointments and crews with provider reconciliation.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Provider event receipts reconciled before final state.

templates.name: Estimate Builder
templates.purpose: Create a versioned estimate from approved scope and assumptions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: No AI-decided price or terms.

templates.name: Proposal Builder
templates.purpose: Assemble an approved estimate into a proof-backed decision document.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Every proof block points to verified content.

templates.name: Agreement / Payment Monitor
templates.purpose: Show proposal, agreement, checkout, payment, refund, and reconciliation status.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Canonical payment facts from verified webhooks.

templates.name: Project Workspace
templates.purpose: Operate project scope, schedule, assignments, updates, files, approvals, and closeout.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Every customer-visible fact explicitly marked.

templates.name: Crew Assignment
templates.purpose: Assign projects and tasks without exposing unauthorized customer data.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Assignment grant controls downstream visibility.

templates.name: Files / Vault
templates.purpose: Manage business, project, and public media files with privacy classes and retention.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Public publication is explicit and reviewed.

templates.name: Change Orders
templates.purpose: Create, send, reconcile, and close scope changes.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Version and decision evidence required.

templates.name: Tasks / SLA
templates.purpose: Make due work visible and connect every task to a canonical record.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Snooze and completion audited.

templates.name: Automation Center
templates.purpose: Show workflow definitions, runs, failures, retries, and manual approval hooks.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Permissions and idempotency verified before retry.

templates.name: Integration Health
templates.purpose: Inventory Vercel-connected resources, provider state, webhooks, and reconciliation health.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Never reveal secret values.

templates.name: Content / CMS
templates.purpose: Create, review, preview, and publish governed content versions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Publication authorization and provenance required.

templates.name: SEO / GBP Workspace
templates.purpose: Manage route health, local proof, content opportunities, and approval-gated GBP actions.
templates.serverClientBoundary: GBP mutation remains explicit approval.

templates.name: Reviews / Referrals
templates.purpose: Track honest review invitations, support cases, referral codes, and attribution.
templates.serverClientBoundary: No rating-based review gating.

templates.name: Analytics / Attribution
templates.purpose: Connect acquisition and experience events to canonical leads, opportunities, projects, and payments.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Server facts, no PII in analytics payloads.

templates.name: Users / Roles
templates.purpose: Manage invitations, roles, MFA requirements, status, and resource grants.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Owner-only privileged administration.

templates.name: Settings
templates.purpose: Manage governed company, workflow, publication, and environment-safe settings.
templates.serverClientBoundary: Secret values are never displayed or stored in public config.
